ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this“Agreement"), made as of September 10, 2015, by and between 238 Livingston St. Realty Corp., a New York corporation having an address at 222 Livingston Street, Brooklyn NY 11201 ("Owner") and 210 Livingston St. Owner LLC, a Delaware limited liability corporation having an address at c/o Rose Associates, 200 Madison Avenue, Fifth Floor, New York, NY 10016 ("Developer"). RECITALS: 1.Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and other improvements thereon as of the date hereof, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, in the City and State of New York, known by the street address of 222 Livingston Street and as Tax Lot 13 of Block 165 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map"), as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Owner Land"; said buildings, together with any further additions, alterations or replacements thereof, being herein called the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and Owner Building, collectively, being herein called the “Owner Premises"); 2. Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land and the improvements thereon located in the Borough of Brooklyn, in the City and State of New York, known by the street address of 210 Livingston Street and as Tax Lot 1 of Block 165 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Developer Land"); 3. Developer intends to construct a new building on the Developer Land, and intends to construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the *"Developer Premises"); 4. The Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Transferred Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization in the Developer Premises. 5. Developer desires to acquire from Owner 9,856 square feet of floor area (the Transferred Development Rights"); 6. Owner desires to retain and does hereby retain the right to utilize 5,708 square feet of floor area (as the same may be increased or decreased in accordance with this Agreement, the “Retained Development Rights"); 1 USIOBRIEWE\9928378.6
